notes.title: 80% Discount in price
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42535914/44fefe06e13c47fcdd3dd71c0d281a10589e1a06.png[/img] As a solo developer i am striving very hard on bringing something nice, new and unique to my customers out there so i take their contributions, impression and decision in to account whether good or bad... after a notable analysis i made, i figured that the average testers and purchasers of this game think its over priced and they want it to be sold at $1.99 and also mentioned a bunch of issues and features that needs to be added (credit: FluffeyPanda's World, DE- Community and Blitz_rgg) for running the game and making their recommendations on it and also requesting few features and noticeable bug that needs to be added and fixed... meanwhile you can still enjoy the  game before the new update are rolled out and the prices spikes up again... for now its a great offer and once purchased you can update it for free when the new updates are out... for now we are bent on satisfying our customers so till the new updates are out please make do the available and also a Big credit to ( Russelhemphil2025 and infinite Retro as a day one customer whom regardless of the bugs still played and made fun out of the game i am highly grateful here is a link to their videos for Reference sake. Link: https://youtu.be/P-fTokwv-x4 and Link: https://youtu.be/57xTDuApxSU 
Thank you
yours truly Flint.
